subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should `SessionCatalogProvider.createSession` become the supported plugin contract for catalogs to launch the core new-session flow with a provider-selected model?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but accepting a permanent plugin-facing capability and gateway response field requires explicit ownership of its compatibility and future extension semantics.

options.title: Accept the additive capability
options.body: Keep the generic optional field, confirm its public compatibility expectations, and require focused contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep creation bundled-only
options.body: Avoid expanding the plugin contract and implement the Claude Code creation affordance through a private bundled-plugin/UI seam.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive capability
recommendation.body: Keep the generic optional field, confirm its public compatibility expectations, and require focused contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed cross-layer implementation and are the only evidence-backed repository member directly associated with this capability in the available review context.
